ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "missionSupported": false, "message": "No starships satisfy the supplied mission parameters.", "matchingShips": [] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json import * from dw::core::Strings fun toNumber(value) = if ( value == null or value == "unknown" or value == "n/a" or value == "none" ) 0 else (value replace "," with "") as Number --- payload.results map (ship) -> { name: ship.name, model: ship.model, starshipClass: ship.starship_class, maxCargoWeight: toNumber(ship.cargo_capacity), maxCrew: if (ship.crew contains "-") substringAfter(ship.crew, "-") else ship.crew, maxPassengers: toNumber(ship.passengers), hyperdriveRating: toNumber(ship.hyperdrive_rating) }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var matchingShips = payload filter (ship) ->
ship.maxPassengers >= vars.missionCriteria.passengers
and
( vars.missionCriteria.cargoWeight == null or ship.maxCargoWeight >= vars.missionCriteria.cargoWeight )
and
( !vars.missionCriteria.requiresHyperdrive or ship.hyperdriveRating <= 2 ) --- { missionSupported: !isEmpty(matchingShips),
message: if (isEmpty(matchingShips)) "No starships satisfy the supplied mission requirements." else sizeOf(matchingShips) ++ " starship(s) satisfy the mission requirements.",
matchingShips: matchingShips }
